title: M-STATE — the world's memory: world/ files + tools/world.py + validation
desc:
DELIVERABLE: tools/world.py (the only writer of world/) + the world/ file layout per docs/WORLD.md v1 + tests/test_world.py — in dreamer2664/mars. Subcommands: join, move, where, propose, respond, decide, archive add, status (pc and video may land in M-LOCK/M-PIPE; wire the module boundaries now and stub them cleanly).
Every write: pull -> read -> modify -> commit -> push with retry. On a REAL conflict (the field you touched changed under you) refuse and report — never overwrite a stranger's change. Every change attributable inside the file (who/what/when/why). Deterministic JSON (pick one style, sort keys, test it twice byte-identical).
EVIDENCE: exit-0 dry runs; a scripted 2-actor scenario pasted with output (join, move, propose, respond, decide); a forced conflict case where one writer is refused with a clear message; tests/test_world.py 8+ checks (idempotent join, unknown-name refusal, malformed-file refusal, conflict refusal, deterministic bytes).
OWNS: world/, tools/world.py, tests/test_world.py.
READ FIRST: CHARTER.md (law) + docs/WORLD.md (frozen interface). If the spec is wrong, change the SPEC first, then the code.
BRANCH: agent/<you>/<task-id>
